headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 43.9/100; Luzon Strait is the lead driver, +43% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **43.9/100** (**high**), up 2.9 pts week-over-week. 4 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Luzon Strait**, running **137.0/day** vs a normal of **96.0/day** (+43%).
**384** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Strait of Hormuz** is running **63% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$91.82/bbl** (-8.46% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$407.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$6.0M** cost-of-delay ($3.2M–$9.6M).
